audit_scope.task_scope: cell-state mapping and retrospective RNA-conditioned ATAC

midas_local.corpus: No upstream checkpoint or pretrained corpus; only declared outer-training donor mosaic matrices

interpretation: MIDAS has no foundation-checkpoint contamination when every model is trained inside its outer donor partition. Its principal risks are false positional pairing, feature or peak unions, query-derived batch dimensions, unknown technical-category handling, feature-order omission from the upstream save manifest, unsafe torch.load(weights_only=False), query fine-tuning, and profile inference that silently supplies target ATAC. The v0.3 architecture can decode missing ATAC in principle, but its official save/load interface is not sufficient evidence of frozen RNA-only held-donor transfer.
remaining_blockers: Implement a tensor-only saved-training-architecture adapter that freezes ordered genes, peaks, chromosome chunks, dimensions, transformations, missing-state mapping, and technical-category policy.
Prove query construction supplies RNA rows and an explicit structurally missing ATAC state with zero ATAC observations, not an all-zero target matrix, and performs no optimization.
Validate exact ordered same-nucleus IDs before placing GSE296875 RNA and ATAC in one MultiModalDataset; force GSE244832 aliquots into separate modality batches.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well/reference/peak/QC gates pass and freeze all preprocessing inside outer-training donors.
Freeze explicit real-data configuration rather than high-level toy defaults, plus donor-grouped validation, early stopping, common/native heads, calibration, and five seeds.
Prohibit MIDAS.load weights_only=False and any reference-to-query fine-tuning on held/sealed rows; use only project-trusted tensor state.
Validate scmidas 0.3.0 on L40S for import, chromosome-factorized sparse/dense paths, forward/backward, tensor-only resume, DDP behavior, deterministic seeds, cross-device tolerance, and memory.
Confirm GSE289173 is used only for RNA cell-state mapping and not as an ATAC profile seal.
sealed_champion_eligibility: blocked_pending_frozen_query_adapter_data_pairing_safe_loading_runtime_and_no_held_ATAC_fixtures; cell-state eligible in principle, RNA-conditioned ATAC remains retrospective without an ATAC seal
